title: Pi Kappa Phi Store
subtitle: Custom chapter commerce platform
description: A custom PHP apparel storefront and order-management system for Pi Kappa Phi.

components.heading: Pi Kappa Phi Apparel
paragraphs: The chapter store turns apparel ordering into a focused self-service experience. Members can browse products, choose sizes and quantities, submit orders, and review their activity from a responsive interface.

Behind the storefront, an administrative workspace manages products, customers, access, and orders without requiring a database. The system uses structured JSON storage with safe reads, atomic writes, validation, and session-aware workflows.
A later security and UX pass added CSRF protection, server-side order validation, input escaping, stronger sessions, mobile layouts, and consistent product-management patterns across the platform.
